question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Boisterous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Quiet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Boisterous"** means noisy, energetic, and cheerful; it often refers to someone or something that is overly loud and lively. (शोरगुल वाला, उग्र)

 
 
• **Example:** The children were boisterous during the birthday party, running and shouting everywhere.
 
 
 
• **"Quiet"** refers to a state or condition where there is little or no noise; it is the opposite of being boisterous. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example:** She enjoyed the quiet atmosphere of the library for studying.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"Boisterous"** is **"Quiet"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Quiet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Noisy** (शोरगुल वाला): Producing or causing a lot of noise.

 
 
• **Example:** The noisy crowd made it difficult to concentrate on the speech.
 
 
 
• **Cheerful** (प्रसन्न): Showing happiness or joy.
 
 
• **Example:** Her cheerful attitude lifted everyone's mood during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Bossy** (हुक्म चलाने वाला): Inclined to give orders in a domineering manner.
 
 
• **Example:** His bossy behavior made it difficult for the team to work together.
